_note: Newest first. tag: Case study | Lesson | Homework | Update. go: guides, homework, cases, dictionary, playground (optional). The Home page shows the first 4.

items.title: Six new study guides
items.text: Looker Studio, Power BI Basics, DAX and Dashboard Design, Structuring Questions, Metrics and Deep Dives, and Storytelling and Bias. Each has four case-style practices with hints, checked numbers and a small tool to try.

items.title: Lessons are now labelled by name
items.text: Guides and homework use the lesson name instead of a number, so you can start anywhere. Your saved progress and old links still work.

items.title: Homework answers now live in one place
items.text: The Study Guides keep the classwork. Every homework question for Get into SQL through Subquery, CTE and Window Functions is in the Homework tab: try it first, run your query, then open the model answer.

items.title: Your progress follows your login
items.text: Questions you finished and queries you wrote are saved to your account, so you can pick up on another laptop or phone.

items.title: Study guides for the SQL lessons
items.text: A one-page recap per lesson, the classwork solved step by step, and small labs to try. The data dictionary sits next to them.

items.title: 14 case studies on real business questions
items.text: Each one starts from a request, lets you plan the approach first, then solves, charts and concludes. 11 run live on the class tables.
